Hi Priya —

Happy to join the call on Wed 3/17 at 9am PT. Quick answers to the questions you raised so you have context before the demo:

- Short-lived tokens: Yes — we support short-lived, rotating API tokens via our API Gateway and recommend using GitHub Actions OIDC to mint federation tokens (we can show a sample GitHub workflow during the call).
- Self-hosted runners: Redwood works with self-hosted runners. Typical pattern is to run a lightweight client or use signed requests to our private endpoints; we’ll walk through options (VPC private deployment vs. hosted with encrypted transit) depending on your security posture.
- Sensitive CI logs: We recommend scrubbing PII from logs and using request-level metadata to avoid logging payloads. For Private deployments we provide configurable audit/log retention and KMS/HSM integration.

I attached a short one-pager that outlines the GitHub integration patterns and a sample workflow.

See you Wed — I’ll join from our solutions engineering account.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
